faq.1.a: It stands for Structurally Enhanced Evaporative Cooling, the same physics that cools your skin when sweat evaporates, built into a deployable system for farm and vendor use.
faq.2.q: How does the ColdEasy Box work without electricity?
faq.2.a: The wet SEEC pad draws in warm, dry air. Water evaporates and absorbs heat, dropping the temperature inside, with no compressor, refrigerant or electricity.
faq.3.q: Can I store meat, fish or dairy?
faq.3.a: No. It works best for fruits, vegetables and flowers.
faq.5.q: Can it be used during transport?
faq.5.a: Yes, it is lightweight and portable.
faq.6.q: Does the moisture cause pests or fungus?
faq.7.q: How do I become a distributor?

about.headline: Built for the people who grow India's food.
about.intro: Fresh produce begins losing vitality the instant it is harvested from the soil. In our hot climate, lack of accessible cooling at farm collection centres and roadside markets forces farmers into quick distress selling. ColdEasy was founded to deliver natural, electricity-free cooling hardware directly into grower and vendor hands.
about.vision: A future where people in low-resource environments can achieve higher incomes and better quality of life through affordable and sustainable cooling solutions.
about.mission: To build innovative, energy-efficient cooling and cold storage solutions that enable farmers, street vendors, and communities to reduce post-harvest losses, increase productivity, and exercise greater agency.
about.team_sub: Engineers, product designers, and technicians united by clean cold tech.
impact.headline: Cooling for a Resilient Future
impact.sub: Affordable cooling that helps people protect produce, strengthen incomes and build resilience.
impact.desc: Decentralized evaporative cooling placed at farm gates, aggregation sheds, and roadside stalls eliminates post-harvest deterioration where infrastructure is weakest.
impact.loss_1: When ambient heat wilts and softens harvested vegetables within hours, smallholder growers and micro-vendors face an immediate penalty: forced price markdowns or total discard.
impact.loss_2: Without electricity-free cooling options at harvest points, farmers cannot wait for fair pricing, and street vendors absorb losses daily from shrinkage. Decentralizing cooling directly at the point of sale converts potential waste into reliable, protected household earnings.
impact.photo_sub: Vegetable retailer market stall with ColdEasy Box crate
impact.photo_caption: Empowering smallholder retailers to retain harvest freshness throughout the day.
science.sub: How science keeps your produce fresher for longer.
science.body: Fresh fruits and vegetables are living organisms that respire, losing moisture and marketability rapidly after harvest. Without electricity or chemical refrigerants, ColdEasy arrests decay through natural thermodynamic airflow.
science.intro_1: Global food loss and waste: [TBC]. The food was grown and harvested, but without cold storage and proper conditions to keep it fresh, it simply spoils.
science.intro_2: We believe this post-harvest loss is one of the most solvable crises because it is caused by the absence of infrastructure. Solving it must be a priority, as it sits directly at the intersection of livelihoods, nutrition security, and environmental sustainability. It is entirely solvable with the infrastructure designed specifically for the needs of farmers, vendors, and retailers.
